source.title: Assessment of Regional Language Varieties in Indian Sign Language

lexical_loci_visually_checked.label: Table 2. Wordlist for sign language lexical similarity assessment in India
lexical_loci_visually_checked.content: 245 numbered English elicitation glosses only; superscripts mark picture cues and iconic items

lexical_loci_visually_checked.label: Appendix G. Lexical Similarity Scores for Each Word for All Cities' Comparisons
lexical_loci_visually_checked.content: the same English glosses, ten pairwise city similarity scores, and a mean; no sign representation

inspection.figure_2_disposition: generic wordlist elicitation setup silhouette, not an item-level lexical form
inspection.unavailable_underlying_material: The report says elicitation was recorded on video and that representative city lists were compared, but none of those sign tokens or recordings is included or linked in the publication.

editorial_disposition.reason: English meanings and numeric similarity judgments are analysis data, not lexical sign forms. No published representation can be mapped into Jambu without inventing forms or coercing scores into the spoken-form schema.
editorial_disposition.transcription_decision: No transcription is possible or required because the underlying signs are not published. No OCR, PDF text, numeric score, or secondary source supplied a lexical reading.
editorial_disposition.reference_gate: inapplicable_no_lexical_source_rows; bibliographic identity retained in this inspection and the survey census
editorial_disposition.language_dialect_gate: inapplicable_no_forms; do not create pseudo-varieties from score columns
